pages.text: Draw your first pentacle. Occultism is the T3 ritual magic mod: demon summoning, soul extraction, a storage dimension and ritual crafting.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Occultism's Dimensional Storage is the best personal storage you can get at T3. Void Summoner builds use Soul Gems, and rituals offer their own crafting routes for several T3 recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Void Summoner synergy:$() Every death within 16 blocks heals a Void Summoner through Soul Tether, the kills of Occultism's summons included.
$(bold)Main rituals:$() The Golden Sacrifice converts mob spawners, the Possession ritual captures entities for dimensional storage, and Summoning rituals bring you crafting assistants.

$(bold)Craft the Dictionary of Spirits$() for the full Occultism reference: ritual circles, spirit summoning, djinn work orders and storage systems. If you lose it, the in-game JEI integration has the same contents.$(br2)$(bold)Next: summon the Foliot Crusher$(), the Dictionary's first ritual and the best project to start with.
